bibliographic.title: Devotion
bibliographic.author: HeartForge
bibliographic.description:
A long struggle ends today.
You are the Iron Consort, partner and oracle for the Iron Scion—your wife, Drusa. The two of you have been locked in a prolonged war of succession against her uncle, and thus far your powers have kept the two of you one step ahead of defeat. The battle today will decide your fates.

Written for the 2024 Single Choice Jam.
